title: What if you jumped in a falling elevator?

lines.vo: What if your elevator fell, and you jumped right before impact?
Sounds smart. Cancel the fall, land softly.
But after ten floors, you're dropping about fifty miles per hour.
lines.cap: But after 10 floors, you're dropping about 50 miles per hour.

lines.vo: Your best jump? Only about five.
You'd still slam down at around forty five.
lines.cap: You'd still slam down at around 45.

lines.vo: While falling, you float. Nothing to push off.
Good news: it almost never happens.
Elevators hang from several steel cables. Each one can usually hold the car alone.
And safety brakes clamp the rails if it speeds up.
So don't jump. The brakes have your back. Follow for more what ifs.
